name: optcatalog_get_captured_hit_source_ptr
description: OptCatalog::GetCapturedHitSourcePtr returns the captured damage source-position buffer, immediately followed by the captured hit-position vector.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the zWeapon/OptCatalog source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b2910 validates returning the address of the captured damage source-position global; callers consume that zVec3 and the following captured hit-position zVec3.
The native smoke verifies the returned pointer is the captured source vector and that the adjacent vector is the captured hit position.
